name: Tiszapalkonya (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszapalkonya: a blue shield with a white bird and a yellow wavy stripe, between ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed TISZAPALKONYA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszapalkonya arms with grain and scroll
